distractors: Held back in reserve so that it can be released later, when the case for spending it is easier to make.
Spread thinly but evenly across the whole, so that everywhere has a little of it and nowhere has enough of it to matter to anyone.
Under one person's control or influence to the point where their view decides the outcome, whatever the process on paper happens to say. It is said about people, and it is never said kindly.

Set aside inside a budget as contingency against something that has not happened yet, and quietly defended all year by whoever holds it. It is money that exists on the plan and is not meant to be spent.

Growing steadily outward from a single starting point, so that the edge moves further out each quarter and everything behind the edge is already covered. The spread is continuous, which is exactly what makes the progress easy to forecast.
